016   二零二五年度報告   ANNUAL REPORT 2025
主席報告
CHAIRMAN’S STATEMENT


本人欣然向各位股東提呈本公司及本集                   I am pleased to present to the shareholders a review of the
團截至二零二五年十二月三十一日止年                   performance of the Company and the Group for the year ended
度之業績回顧與展望。                          31 December 2025 and our outlook.

二零二五年是「十四五」規劃的收官之年，                 2025 marked the concluding year of the 14th Five-Year Plan.
面 對 複 雜 多 變 的 內 外 部 發 展 環 境，我 國     Amid a complex and volatile internal and external development
經濟展現出強勁韌性與穩健復甦態勢，                   landscape, China’s economy demonstrated strong resilience and
高 質 量 發 展 取 得 紮 實 成 效。房 地 產 行 業     a steady recovery, and solid achievements were made in high-
仍處於深度調整與模式重構的關鍵時期，                  quality development. The real estate sector remained in a critical
行 業 發 展 邏 輯 深 刻 重 塑，由 規 模 擴 張 轉     period of profound adjustment and model restructuring, with
向 質 效 提 升。隨 著 穩 預 期、優 供 給、防         its development logic fundamentally reshaped as it shifted from
風 險、促 轉 型 等 宏 觀 政 策 協 同 發 力、精       scale expansion to quality and efficiency improvement. As macro
準 落 地，市 場 信 心 穩 步 修 復，行 業 格 局       policies including stabilizing expectations, optimizing supply,
持 續 優 化，邁 入 高 質 量、內 涵 式 發 展 的       preventing risks and promoting transformation were deployed
新階段。                                in a coordinated and targeted manner, the market confidence
                                    continued to strengthen, the industry structure continued to
                                    improve, and the industry accelerated into a new stage of high-
                                    quality, intensive development.

面 對 行 業 發 展 的 新 階 段、新 格 局，本 集       Facing the new stage and landscape of industry development, the
團始終堅守「城市投資開發運營商」的戰                  Group has firmly adhered to its strategic positioning as an “urban
略 定 位，加 力 推 進 轉 型 創 新，積 極 搶 抓       investor, developer and operator”, accelerating transformation
政 策 機 遇，堅 決 守 穩 開 發 業 務 基 本 盤，      and innovation, actively seizing policy opportunities, and
鞏 固 拓 展 第 二 增 長 曲 線，縱 深 推 進 組 織     resolutely stabilizing the core business of property development,
變 革，全 面 夯 實 發 展 根 基，經 營 業 績 持       consolidating and expanding the second growth curve, deepening
續領跑行業。                              organization-wide restructuring, and comprehensively fortifying
                                    the foundation for sustainable growth, delivering operating
                                    performance that continued to lead the industry.

二 零 二 五 年，本 集 團 實 現 營 業 收 入 人 民     In 2025, the Group achieved revenue of RMB281.44 billion, profit
幣 2,814.4 億 元，股 東 應 佔 淨 利 潤 人 民     attributable to shareholders of RMB25.42 billion and core net
幣 254.2 億 元，核 心 淨 利 潤 人 民 幣 224.8   profit of RMB22.48 billion, significantly stronger than the broader
億 元，顯 著 優 於 大 市。其 中，經 常 性 業         market. Among them, the Group’s core net profit from recurring
務 核 心 淨 利 潤 同 比 增 長 13.1% 至 人 民 幣   business rose 13.1% YoY to RMB11.65 billion, with its share in
116.5 億 元，佔 核 心 淨 利 潤 比 重 攀 升 至     total core net profit climbing to 51.8%. This signifies the Group’s
51.8%，標 誌 著 本 集 團 率 先 完 成 向「開       pioneering strategic shift toward a multi-track, diversified growth
發、運營、服務」相關多元多賽道驅動的                  model driven by development, operation and services, opening
戰 略 躍 遷，以 經 營 的 確 定 性 開 啟 本 集 團     a new chapter of value re-rating and high-quality development
價值重估與高質量發展的新篇章。                     underpinned by operational certainty.

 公平值計量                           FAIR VALUE MEASUREMENT
 公平值為於計量當日在市場參與者                 Fair value is the price that would be received to sell an
 之間於有序交易中出售資產所收取                 asset or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction
 或轉讓負債所支付的價格，不管該                 between market participants at the measurement date,
 價格是否可直接觀察得到或使用另                 regardless of whether that price is directly observable or
 一估值技巧而估計。於估計資產或                 estimated using another valuation technique. In estimating
 負債的公平值時，倘市場參與者於                 the fair value of an asset or a liability, the Group takes into
 計量當日為資產或負債定價時將會                 account the characteristics of the asset or liability if market
 考慮的資產或負債的特點時，則本                 participants would take those characteristics into account
 集團會考慮該等特點。                      when pricing the asset or liability at the measurement date.

 非金融資產公平值之計量則參考市                 A fair value measurement of a non-financial asset takes into
 場參與者可從使用該資產得到之最                 account a market participant’s ability to generate economic
 高及最佳效用，或把該資產售予另                 benefits by using the asset in its highest and best use or by
 一可從使用該資產得到最高及最佳                 selling it to another market participant that would use the
 效用之市場參與者所產生之經濟效                 asset in its highest and best use.
 益。

 此 外，就 財 務 報 告 而 言，公 平 值 計       In addition, for financial reporting purposes, fair value
 量乃根據公平值計量輸入數據的可                 measurements are categorised into Level 1, 2 or 3 based
 觀察程度及公平值計量輸入數據的                 on the degree to which the inputs to the fair value
 整體重要性而劃分為第一級、第二                 measurements are observable and the significance of the
 級或第三級，詳述如下：                     inputs to the fair value measurement in its entirety, which
                                 are described as follows:

 •   第一級輸入數據為該實體可於               •    Level 1 inputs are quoted prices (unadjusted) in active
     計量當日自相同資產或負債的                    markets for identical assets or liabilities that the entity
     活 躍 市 場 取 得 的 報 價（未 經 調          can access at the measurement date;
     整）；

 •   第二級輸入數據為第一級內所               •    Level 2 inputs are inputs, other than quoted prices
     載報價以外就資產或負債可直                    included within Level 1, that are observable for the
     接或間接觀察的輸入數據；及                    asset or liability, either directly or indirectly; and

 •   第三級輸入數據為就資產或負               •    Level 3 inputs are unobservable inputs for the asset or
     債而無法觀察的輸入數據。                     liability.

16. 投資物業（續）                   16. INVESTMENT PROPERTIES (continued)
  附註：                           Notes:

  (a)   本集團的估值程序                (a)      Valuation processes of the Group

        本集團按公平值對其投資物業進行計量。本              The Group measures its investment properties at fair value. The fair value of the
        集團投資物業於二零二五年十二月三十一               Group’s investment properties as at 31 December 2025 has been determined
        日的公平值是根據仲量聯行企業評估及諮               on the basis of valuation carried out by Jones Lang LaSalle Corporate Appraisal
        詢有限公司及萊坊有限責任合夥（均為獨立              and Advisory Limited and Knight Frank LLP, both are independent and
        及專業合資格估值師）進行的估值而釐定。              professionally qualified valuers.

        管理層與估值師每六個月最少對估值程序               Discussions of valuation processes and results are held between management
        及結果進行一次討論，與本集團之中期及年              and valuers at least once every six months, in line with the timing of Group’s
        度報告時間一致。                         interim and annual reporting.

  (b)   估值技術                    (b)      Valuation techniques

        估值採用之估值方法包括已落成物業所用               The valuation methodologies adopted in valuations include income
        的收益資本化法，在建物業所用的剩餘法、              capitalisation method for completed properties and residual method, direct
        直接比較法及╱或成本法，以及使用權資產              comparison method and/or cost method for the properties under construction
        所用之收益資本化法。                       and income capitalisation method for the right-of-use assets.

        收益資本化法通過計算標的物業當前租約               The income capitalisation method operates by taking into account the rental
        的租金收入，並計算出租及空置部分的潛在              income of the subject property derived from the existing tenancies with due
        租金收入，然後按合適的資本化率將其資本              allowance for the potential reversionary income of the tenanted and vacant
        化為價值。                            portions, which are then capitalised at an appropriate capitalisation rate.

        直接比較法涉及分析近期巿場上同類型物               The direct comparison method involves the analysis of recent market evidence
        業的案例並與該等估值物業進行比較。選取              of similar properties and comparing them with the subject property under
        面積大小、屬性及位置類近的可資比較物業              valuation. Comparable properties with similar size, characteristics and locations
        進行分析，並仔細權衡各自的優劣之處，從              are analysed, and carefully weighed against all respective advantage and
        而達至公允的評估價值。                      disadvantages in order to arrive at a fair comparison of value.

        剩餘法考慮總發展價值並扣除尚未發生的建              The residual method takes into account the residual value of the gross
        築成本、開支以及發展利潤後的剩餘價值。              development value (“GDV”) after deduction of the outstanding construction
        剩餘法首先計算假設建議發展項目於估值               costs and expenses as well as profit element. It involves firstly the assessment
        日已落成的合計總發展價值。建議發展項目              of the aggregate GDV of the proposed development, as if completed, as at
        的估計成本包括建築成本、市場推廣支出、              the valuation date. Estimated costs of the proposed development include
        專業費用、財務費用以及相關成本，另加發              construction costs, marketing expense, professional fee, finance charges and
        展商的風險及利潤撥備。尚未發生的開發成              associated costs, plus an allowance for the developer’s risk and profit. The
        本將自總發展價值中扣除，並得出標的物業              outstanding development costs are then deducted from the GDV and the
        的剩餘價值。                           resultant figure is the residual value of the subject property.

       款的供應商提供較相關發票付款到期日為                                     provide the willing suppliers early payment terms, compared with the related

52. 資本風險管理                      52. CAPITAL RISK MANAGEMENT
  本集團管理資本以確保本集團各實                 The Group manages its capital to ensure that entities in
  體可以持續經營，並通過優化債務                 the Group will be able to continue as a going concern
  及權益結餘為股東帶來最大回報。                 while maximising the return to shareholders through the
  本集團之整體策略與上年度保持一                 optimisation of the debt and equity balance. The Group’s
  致。                              overall strategy remains unchanged from the prior year.

  本 集 團 之 資 本 架 構 包 括 淨 債 務（包     The capital structure of the Group consists of net debts,
  括 銀 行 及 其 他 借 貸、優 先 票 據、超       which include bank and other borrowings, senior notes,
  短期融資券以及中期票據，扣除現                 super short-term commercial papers and medium-term
  金及現金等值）、應付關聯方款項、                notes, net of cash and cash equivalents, amount due to
  應付非控股權益款項以及本公司擁                 related parties, amounts due to non-controlling interests and
  有 人 應 佔 權 益（包 括 已 發 行 股 本 及     equity attributable to owners of the Company, comprising
  其他儲備）。                          issued share capital and other reserves.

  本公司董事定期檢討資本架構。於                 The directors of the Company review the capital structure on
  檢討時，董事考慮資本成本及與各                 a regular basis. As part of this review, the directors consider
  資本類別相關之風險。根據董事之                 the cost of capital and the risks associated with each class
  建 議，本 集 團 將 透 過 支 付 股 息、發       of capital. Based on recommendations of the directors, the
  行新股、購回股份及發行新債務或                 Group will balance its overall capital structure through the
  贖回現有債務，平衡整體資本架構。                payment of dividends, new share issues and share buy-
                                  backs as well as the issue of new debts or the redemption of
                                  existing debts.

  員 薪 金 5% 供 款，每 月 供 款 上 限 為     employer and its employees are required to contribute 5%
  每名僱員港幣 1,500 元。強積金計劃           of the employee’s salaries, up to a maximum of HK$1,500
  資產由獨立管理基金持有，與集團                per employee per month. The assets of the MPF Scheme
  公司資產分開持有。此等計劃供款                are held separately from those of the group companies in
  於相關服務期間內的服務完成後立                an independently administered fund. Contributions to these
  即歸屬。                           plans vest immediately upon the completion of the services
